# LAMPS composite known-answer vector

`lamps-mldsa44-ed25519.json` is the `id-MLDSA44-Ed25519-SHA512` known-answer
vector of `draft-ietf-lamps-pq-composite-sigs`, copied unchanged from
`stalwartlabs/mail-auth` (Apache-2.0 OR MIT) at commit
`8d153e523a023d85acf043c8654f60bc4d344014` (`resources/dkim2/`). The DKIM2
reference implementation tests against the same file. It is public test
material and protects nothing.
